mapper.select:
WITH STOCK AS ( SELECT s.area_cd ,s.storage_cd ,s.item_type_cd ,s.item_cd ,s.item_name ,s.test_no ,s.qty FROM dbo.fn_get_stock( CAST(#{stdDate} AS DATE) ,#{areaCd} ,NULL ,#{itemTypeCd} ,#{itemCd} ,#{itemName} ,#{type} ,NULL ) s )
,SAFE_STOCK AS ( SELECT d.item_cd ,MAX(ISNULL(d.safe_stock_qty, 0)) AS safeStockQty FROM dbo.tb_item_detail d GROUP BY d.item_cd ) ,PUR_ORDER AS ( SELECT b.item_cd ,SUM(ISNULL(b.qty, 0)) AS inReQty FROM dbo.tb_pur_order_mst a INNER JOIN dbo.tb_pur_order_item b ON a.pur_order_id = b.pur_order_id WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(a.end_yn)) = 'N' GROUP BY b.item_cd ) SELECT s.area_cd ,s.storage_cd ,s.item_type_cd ,s.item_cd ,s.item_name ,s.test_no ,s.qty ,ISNULL(p.inReQty, 0) AS inReQty ,ISNULL(sf.safeStockQty, 0) AS safeStockQty FROM STOCK s LEFT JOIN SAFE_STOCK sf ON s.item_cd = sf.item_cd LEFT JOIN PUR_ORDER p ON s.item_cd = p.item_cd ORDER BY s.area_cd ,s.storage_cd
SELECT s.area_cd ,s.storage_cd ,s.item_type_cd ,s.item_cd ,s.item_name ,s.test_no ,s.qty ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS inReQty ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS safeStockQty FROM STOCK s ORDER BY s.item_cd, s.test_no
OPTION (RECOMPILE)

select s.test_no as testNo ,( select tran_date from tb_inv_tran_mst where tran_id in ( select tran_id from tb_inv_tran_item where test_no = s.test_no ) and tran_type_cd ='A' ) as inDate ,s.storage_cd as storageCd ,SUM(s.qty) as qty ,b.expiry_date as expiryDate from dbo.fn_get_stock( COALESCE(TRY_CAST(NULLIF(CAST(#{stdDate} AS NVARCHAR(20)), '') AS DATE),CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) -- 재고 기준일 ,#{areaCd} -- 공장 (NULL: 전체) ,NULL -- 창고 (NULL: 전체) ,NULL -- 품목구분 ,#{itemCd} -- 품목코드 ,NULL -- 품목명 ,'TEST' -- ITEM / TEST ,NULL -- 거래유형 (전체) ) s join tb_item_test_no b on b.test_no = s.test_no group by s.test_no,s.storage_cd, b.expiry_date order by s.test_no ASC, inDate ASC

select a.item_cd ,b.item_name ,a.expiry_date ,a.test_no ,DATEDIFF(DAY, #{stdDate}, a.expiry_date) AS remaining_day ,c.customer_name ,a.create_date ,avg(b.in_price) as in_price ,isnull(sum(d.qty), 0) as qty ,isnull(sum(d.qty* b.in_price ), 0) as totPrice from tb_item_test_no a inner join tb_item_mst b on b.item_cd = a.item_cd left outer join tb_customer c on c.customer_cd = a.customer_cd left outer join vw_inv_stock_tran d on d.test_no = a.test_no where a.item_type_cd IN ( 'M2', 'M7')
AND a.expiry_date < DATEADD(MONTH, 3, #{stdDate})
AND a.expiry_date >= DATEADD(MONTH, 3, #{stdDate}) AND a.expiry_date < DATEADD(MONTH, 6, #{stdDate})
AND a.expiry_date >= DATEADD(MONTH, 6, #{stdDate}) AND a.expiry_date < DATEADD(MONTH, 12, #{stdDate})
AND a.expiry_date >= DATEADD(MONTH, 12, #{stdDate}) AND a.expiry_date < DATEADD(MONTH, 24, #{stdDate})
AND a.expiry_date >= DATEADD(MONTH, 24, #{stdDate})
AND a.area_cd LIKE '%' + #{areaCd} + '%'
AND a.item_cd LIKE '%' + #{itemCd} + '%'
AND b.item_name LIKE CONCAT('%', dbo.fn_LikeEscape(#{itemName}), '%')
group by a.item_cd, b.item_name, a.expiry_date, a.test_no, c.customer_name, a.create_date

WITH STOCK AS ( /* ========================================= 1. 공통 기간 재고 함수 - 기초: 조회 시작일 전날 - 기말: 조회 종료일 ========================================= */ SELECT s.item_cd ,SUM(s.begin_qty) AS basicQty ,SUM(s.end_qty) AS finalQty FROM dbo.fn_get_stock_period( #{strDate} ,#{endDate} ,NULL ,NULL ,#{itemTypeCd} ,NULL ,NULL ,'ITEM' ,NULL ) s GROUP BY s.item_cd ),
QTY AS ( /* ========================================= 2. 거래유형별 재고 증감 수량 - vw_inv_stock_movement 기준 - 입고 양수 / 출고 음수 ========================================= */ SELECT v.item_cd
,SUM(CASE WHEN v.tran_type_cd = 'A' THEN v.qty ELSE 0 END) AS a_qty
,SUM(CASE WHEN v.tran_type_cd = 'E' THEN v.qty ELSE 0 END) AS e_qty
,SUM(CASE WHEN v.tran_type_cd = 'P' THEN v.qty ELSE 0 END) AS p_qty
,SUM(CASE WHEN v.tran_type_cd = 'R' THEN v.qty ELSE 0 END) AS r_qty
,SUM(CASE WHEN v.tran_type_cd = 'T' THEN v.qty ELSE 0 END) AS t_qty
,SUM(CASE WHEN v.tran_type_cd = 'Q' THEN v.qty ELSE 0 END) AS q_qty
,SUM(CASE WHEN v.tran_type_cd = 'S' THEN v.qty ELSE 0 END) AS s_qty
,SUM(CASE WHEN v.tran_type_cd = 'V' THEN v.qty ELSE 0 END) AS v_qty
,SUM(CASE WHEN v.tran_type_cd = 'W' THEN v.qty ELSE 0 END) AS w_qty
,SUM(CASE WHEN v.tran_type_cd = 'X' THEN v.qty ELSE 0 END) AS x_qty
,SUM(CASE WHEN v.tran_type_cd = 'U' THEN v.qty ELSE 0 END) AS u_qty
FROM dbo.vw_inv_stock_movement v
INNER JOIN dbo.tb_item_mst im ON v.item_cd = im.item_cd
WHERE v.tran_date >= #{strDate} AND v.tran_date < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(#{endDate} AS DATE)) AND im.item_type_cd = #{itemTypeCd}
AND v.item_cd LIKE '%' + #{itemCd} + '%'
GROUP BY v.item_cd )
/* ========================================= 3. 기존 품목별 수불현황 ========================================= */ SELECT a.item_cd
,ISNULL(c.code_nm, '') AS order_type
,a.item_name
,b.code_nm AS item_type_name
,d.customer_name
,ISNULL(a.in_price, 0) AS in_price
/* 거래유형별 수량 */ ,ISNULL(q.a_qty, 0) AS as_qty ,ISNULL(q.e_qty, 0) AS es_qty ,ISNULL(q.p_qty, 0) AS ps_qty ,ISNULL(q.r_qty, 0) AS rs_qty ,ISNULL(q.t_qty, 0) AS ts_qty ,ISNULL(q.q_qty, 0) AS qs_qty ,ISNULL(q.s_qty, 0) AS ss_qty ,ISNULL(q.v_qty, 0) AS vs_qty ,ISNULL(q.w_qty, 0) AS ws_qty ,ISNULL(q.x_qty, 0) AS xs_qty ,ISNULL(q.u_qty, 0) AS us_qty
/* 거래유형별 금액 */ ,ISNULL(q.a_qty, 0) * ISNULL(a.in_price, 0) AS asAmt
,ISNULL(q.e_qty, 0) * ISNULL(a.in_price, 0) AS esAmt
/* 기초재고 */ ,ISNULL(s.basicQty, 0) AS basicQty
,ISNULL(s.basicQty, 0) * ISNULL(a.in_price, 0) AS basicAmt
/* 기말재고 */ ,ISNULL(s.finalQty, 0) AS finalQty
,ISNULL(s.finalQty, 0) * ISNULL(a.in_price, 0) AS finalAmt
FROM dbo.tb_item_mst a
INNER JOIN dbo.tb_common_code b ON b.com_type_cd = 'item_type_cd' AND b.code = a.item_type_cd
LEFT JOIN dbo.tb_common_code c ON c.com_type_cd = 'ITEM_GRP1' AND c.code = a.item_grp1
LEFT JOIN dbo.tb_customer d ON d.customer_cd = a.customer_cd
LEFT JOIN QTY q ON q.item_cd = a.item_cd
LEFT JOIN STOCK s ON s.item_cd = a.item_cd WHERE a.item_type_cd = #{itemTypeCd}
AND a.item_cd LIKE '%' + #{itemCd} + '%'
AND a.item_name LIKE CONCAT( '%', dbo.fn_LikeEscape(#{itemName}), '%' )
AND c.code LIKE '%' + #{itemGrp1} + '%'
AND ( ISNULL(s.basicQty, 0) != 0 OR ISNULL(q.a_qty, 0) != 0 OR ISNULL(q.e_qty, 0) != 0 OR ISNULL(q.p_qty, 0) != 0 OR ISNULL(q.r_qty, 0) != 0 OR ISNULL(q.t_qty, 0) != 0 OR ISNULL(q.q_qty, 0) != 0 OR ISNULL(q.s_qty, 0) != 0 OR ISNULL(q.v_qty, 0) != 0 OR ISNULL(q.w_qty, 0) != 0 OR ISNULL(q.x_qty, 0) != 0 OR ISNULL(q.u_qty, 0) != 0 OR ISNULL(s.finalQty, 0) != 0 ) ORDER BY a.item_cd
